input_urls <- rmarkdown::metadata$input

# Only proceed if there are URLs in the 'input' field
if (!is.null(input_urls) && length(input_urls) > 0 && any(nzchar(unlist(input_urls)))) {

  # Self-contained CSS for styling the issue list

</style>
")

  # SVG icons for different states
  icons <- list(
    open = '<svg class="gh-icon open" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 9.5a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 0-3 1.5 1.5 0 0 0 0 3Z"></path><path d="M8 0a8 8 0 1 1 0 16A8 8 0 0 1 8 0ZM1.5 8a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 0-13 0Z"></path></svg>',
    closed = '<svg class="gh-icon closed" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 9.5a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 0-3 1.5 1.5 0 0 0 0 3Z"></path><path d="M8 0a8 8 0 1 1 0 16A8 8 0 0 1 8 0ZM1.5 8a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 0-13 0Z"></path></svg>',
    merged = '<svg class="gh-icon merged" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M5 3.25a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm0 2.5a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm-1.5 5a.75.75 0 1 0 0 1.5.75.75 0 0 0 0-1.5Zm2.25-4a.75.75 0 1 0-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 0 1.5 0Zm.75 2.25a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm0 2.5a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm5-4.5a.75.75 0 1 0-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 0 1.5 0Zm.75 2.25a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm0 2.5a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm2.25-4a.75.75 0 1 0-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 0 1.5 0Zm.75 2.25a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Zm0 2.5a.75.75 0 1 1-1.5 0 .75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0Z"></path><path d="M1.5 8a6.5 6.5 0 1 1 13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 1-13 0ZM8 0a8 8 0 1 0 0 16A8 8 0 0 0 8 0Z"></path></svg>',
    draft = '<svg class="gh-icon draft" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 16A8 8 0 1 1 8 0a8 8 0 0 1 0 16ZM4 8a4 4 0 1 0 8 0 4 4 0 0 0-8 0Z"></path></svg>',
    discussion = '<svg class="gh-icon open" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M1 2.75C1 1.784 1.784 1 2.75 1h10.5c.966 0 1.75.784 1.75 1.75v7.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 13.25 12H9.06l-2.573 2.573A1.458 1.458 0 0 1 4 13.543V12H2.75A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 1 10.25Zm1.75-.25a.25.25 0 0 0-.25.25v7.5c0 .138.112.25.25.25h2.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v2.19l2.72-2.72a.749.749 0 0 1 .53-.22h4.25a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-7.5a.25.25 0 0 0-.25-.25Z"></path></svg>'
  )

# Helper function to render GitHub labels from either REST (data.frame) or GraphQL (list)
  # Helper function to render GitHub labels from either REST or GraphQL
  render_labels <- function(labels_data) {
    # GraphQL nests the actual list of labels inside a "nodes" item
    if (is.list(labels_data) && "nodes" %in% names(labels_data)) {
      labels_data <- labels_data$nodes
    }
    
    if (is.null(labels_data) || length(labels_data) == 0 || (is.data.frame(labels_data) && nrow(labels_data) == 0)) {
      return("")
    }
    
    # Force it into a data frame just to be safe
    if (!is.data.frame(labels_data)) {
      labels_data <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, labels_data))
    }
    
    # Loop over the rows by their index number to avoid the atomic vector error
    label_tags <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(labels_data)), function(i) {
      name <- labels_data$name[i]
      color <- labels_data$color[i]
      
      hex <- paste0("#", color)
      rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)
      
      # col2rgb returns a matrix, so we grab row 1 (R), 2 (G), and 3 (B)
      brightness <- (rgb[1, 1] * 299 + rgb[2, 1] * 587 + rgb[3, 1] * 114) / 1000
      text_color <- ifelse(brightness > 128, "#000000", "#ffffff")
      
      sprintf('<span class="gh-label" style="background-color: %s; color: %s;">%s</span>', hex, text_color, name)
    })
    
    paste0('<div class="gh-labels">', paste(label_tags, collapse = " "), '</div>')
  }

render_item <- function(url) {
    repo_match <- stringr::str_match(url, "https://github\\.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/(issues|pull|discussions)/(\\d+)")
    org_match <- stringr::str_match(url, "https://github\\.com/orgs/([^/]+)/discussions/(\\d+)")

    is_repo_match <- !is.na(repo_match[1, 1])
    is_org_match <- !is.na(org_match[1, 1])

    pat <- Sys.getenv("DISCUSSIONS_PAT")
    if (nzchar(pat)) {
      headers <- httr::add_headers(
        "User-Agent" = "NOAA-FIMS-Website-Builder",
        "Authorization" = paste("token", pat)
      )
    } else {
      headers <- httr::add_headers("User-Agent" = "NOAA-FIMS-Website-Builder")
    }

    is_discussion <- is_org_match || (is_repo_match && repo_match[1, 4] == "discussions")
    
    if (is_discussion) {
      if (!nzchar(pat)) {
        return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item"><div class="gh-details"><div class="gh-title">%s</div><div class="gh-meta" style="color:#cf222e;">Cannot fetch: DISCUSSIONS_PAT is missing from .Renviron</div></div></div>', url))
      }
      
      if (is_org_match) {
        org <- org_match[1, 2]
        number <- as.integer(org_match[1, 3])
        # Force the GraphQL query to look inside the backing FIMS repository
        graphql_query <- sprintf('query { repository(owner: "%s", name: "FIMS") { discussion(number: %d) { title, url, closed, labels(first: 10) { nodes { name, color } } } } }', org, number)
        item_path <- c("data", "repository", "discussion")
      } else {
        owner <- repo_match[1, 2]
        repo <- repo_match[1, 3]
        number <- as.integer(repo_match[1, 5])
        graphql_query <- sprintf('query { repository(owner: "%s", name: "%s") { discussion(number: %d) { title, url, closed, labels(first: 10) { nodes { name, color } } } } }', owner, repo, number)
        item_path <- c("data", "repository", "discussion")
      }

      response <- httr::POST("https://api.github.com/graphql", headers, body = list(query = graphql_query), encode = "json")
      raw_text <- httr::content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      content <- jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_text)

      if (httr::status_code(response) != 200 || !is.null(content$errors)) {
        safe_json <- gsub("<", "&lt;", raw_text)
        return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item" style="background:#ffebe9; padding:10px; border:1px solid #cf222e;"><div class="gh-details"><strong>GitHub API Error for %s:</strong><br><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:11px;">%s</pre></div></div>', url, safe_json))
      }

      item <- purrr::pluck(content, .default = NULL, !!!item_path)
      
      if (is.null(item)) {
        safe_json <- gsub("<", "&lt;", raw_text)
        return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item" style="background:#fff8c5; padding:10px; border:1px solid #d4a72c;"><div class="gh-details"><strong>Data Not Found for %s:</strong><br><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:11px;">%s</pre></div></div>', url, safe_json))
      }
      
      state_class <- if (item$closed) "closed" else "open"
      icon_svg <- if (state_class == "closed") icons$closed else icons$discussion
      labels_html <- render_labels(item$labels)

      # Removed the gh-meta div
      return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item"><div class="gh-icon %s">%s</div><div class="gh-details"><div class="gh-title"><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a></div>%s</div></div>', state_class, icon_svg, url, item$title, labels_html))
    }

    # REST API Block
    is_issue_or_pr <- is_repo_match && repo_match[1, 4] %in% c("issues", "pull")
    if (is_issue_or_pr) {
      owner <- repo_match[1, 2]
      repo <- repo_match[1, 3]
      number <- repo_match[1, 5]
      api_url <- paste0("https://api.github.com/repos/", owner, "/", repo, "/issues/", number)
      
      response <- try(httr::GET(api_url, headers), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(response, "try-error") || httr::status_code(response) != 200) {
        return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item"><div class="gh-details"><div class="gh-title">%s</div><div class="gh-meta" style="color:#cf222e;">REST API failed with status %s</div></div></div>', url, httr::status_code(response)))
      }

      item <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
      is_merged <- !is.null(item$pull_request) && !is.null(item$pull_request$merged_at) && !is.na(item$pull_request$merged_at)
      is_draft <- !is.null(item$draft) && item$draft
      
      state_class <- if (is_merged) "merged" else if (is_draft) "draft" else item$state
      icon_svg <- icons[[state_class]]
      labels_html <- render_labels(item$labels)

      # Removed the gh-meta div
      return(sprintf('<div class="gh-list-item"><div class="gh-icon %s">%s</div><div class="gh-details"><div class="gh-title"><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a></div>%s</div></div>', state_class, icon_svg, item$html_url, item$title, labels_html))
    }

    return(paste0("<li><a href='", url, "'>", url, "</a></li>"))
  }

  cat(sapply(unlist(input_urls), render_item), sep = "\n")

} else {
  # Fallback to original announcement logic for backward compatibility
  announcements <- rmarkdown::metadata$announcements
  if (!is.null(announcements) && any(nzchar(unlist(announcements)))) {
    items <- unlist(announcements)
    items <- items[nzchar(trimws(items))]
    cat('<ul>\n')
    for (item in items) {
      cat(paste0('  <li>', item, '</li>\n'))
    }
    cat('</ul>\n')
  } else {
    cat('{{< contents announcements >}}')
  }
}
